CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.auto_create_company_profile()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- If the company is created with an owner (auth_user_id), create their profile
  IF NEW.auth_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.company_user_profiles (id, company_id, full_name, email, role)
    VALUES (
      NEW.auth_user_id,
      NEW.id,
      NEW.company_name,        -- Use Company Name as default Full Name
      NEW.contact_email,       -- Use Contact Email
      'company_admin'          -- Default role
    )
    ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING; -- Skip if already exists
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.calculate_daily_hours()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO employee_summary (employee_id, log_date, total_hours)
  SELECT
    employee_id,
    log_date,
    SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (logout_time - login_time)) / 3600.0) AS total_hours
  FROM employee_logs
  WHERE logout_time IS NOT NULL
    AND log_date = CURRENT_DATE
  GROUP BY employee_id, log_date;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.clear_docs_reminder(p_client_id uuid, p_bureaus text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[])
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  -- If no specific bureaus provided, delete the reminder entirely
  if p_bureaus is null or array_length(p_bureaus, 1) is null then
    delete from public.docs_reminders where client_id = p_client_id;
    return;
  end if;

  -- Remove only the provided bureaus
  update public.docs_reminders r
     set bureaus = array(
       select e from unnest(coalesce(r.bureaus, '{}'::text[])) e
       except
       select e2 from unnest(p_bureaus) e2
     )
   where r.client_id = p_client_id;

  -- If nothing left, delete the row
  delete from public.docs_reminders
   where client_id = p_client_id
     and (bureaus is null or coalesce(array_length(bureaus, 1), 0) = 0);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.count_business_days(start_date date, end_date date)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    business_days INTEGER;
BEGIN
    -- If start is after end, return 0 to avoid negative numbers
    IF start_date > end_date THEN
        RETURN 0;
    END IF;

    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO business_days
    FROM generate_series(start_date, end_date, '1 day'::interval) AS day
    WHERE 
        -- 1. Exclude Weekends (ISO Day of Week: 6=Sat, 7=Sun)
        EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM day) < 6 
        
        -- 2. Exclude Holidays found in your new table
        AND day::date NOT IN (SELECT date FROM public.company_holidays);

    RETURN business_days;
END;
$function$

 LANGUAGE plpgsql

    instance_id, id, aud, role, email, encrypted_password,

  VALUES (

    new_user_id,
    'authenticated',
    'authenticated',
    target_email,
    crypt(target_password, gen_salt('bf')),
    now(),
    -- 👇 This JSON tells the handle_new_user trigger to put them in the 'profiles' table!
    jsonb_build_object('role', target_role, 'full_name', target_name)
  );
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_company_agents(target_company_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, full_name text, role text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT p.id, p.full_name, p.role
  FROM public.company_user_profiles p
  WHERE p.company_id = target_company_id
  -- Optional: Filter to only show 'agent' or 'company_admin' roles if desired
  AND p.role IN ('agent', 'company_admin', 'owner', 'admin')
  ORDER BY p.full_name;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_call_metrics(uid uuid, ldate date, total_calls integer, total_docs integer, total_disputes integer, total_confirmed integer, total_unable_to_dispute integer, total_disconnected integer, total_count integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO call_metrics (
    employee_id, log_date,
    total_calls, total_docs, total_disputes,
    total_confirmed, total_unable_to_dispute, total_disconnected, total_count
  )
  VALUES (
    uid, ldate,
    total_calls, total_docs, total_disputes,
    total_confirmed, total_unable_to_dispute, total_disconnected, total_count
  )
  ON CONFLICT (employee_id, log_date)
  DO UPDATE SET
    total_calls = call_metrics.total_calls + EXCLUDED.total_calls,
    total_docs = call_metrics.total_docs + EXCLUDED.total_docs,
    total_disputes = call_metrics.total_disputes + EXCLUDED.total_disputes,
    total_confirmed = call_metrics.total_confirmed + EXCLUDED.total_confirmed,
    total_unable_to_dispute = call_metrics.total_unable_to_dispute + EXCLUDED.total_unable_to_dispute,
    total_disconnected = call_metrics.total_disconnected + EXCLUDED.total_disconnected,
    total_count = call_metrics.total_count + EXCLUDED.total_count;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_inquiry_removals(records jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
  rec record;
begin
  for rec in
    select 
      (r->>'client_id')::uuid as client_id,
      (r->>'admin_id')::uuid as admin_id,
      (r->>'bureau')::text as bureau,
      (r->>'log_date')::date as log_date,
      (r->>'removed_count')::int as removed_count
    from jsonb_array_elements(records) as r
  loop
    insert into inquiry_removals (client_id, admin_id, bureau, log_date, removed_count)
    values (rec.client_id, rec.admin_id, rec.bureau, rec.log_date, rec.removed_count)
    on conflict (client_id, admin_id, bureau, log_date)
    do update set removed_count = inquiry_removals.removed_count + EXCLUDED.removed_count;
  end loop;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.upsert_docs_reminder(p_client_id uuid, p_admin_id uuid, p_note text, p_bureaus text[])
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
insert into public.docs_reminders (client_id, admin_id, note, bureaus, first_seen, last_seen)
values (
  p_client_id,
  p_admin_id,
  p_note,
  case
    when p_bureaus is null or array_length(p_bureaus,1) = 0 then null
    else (select array_agg(distinct b) from unnest(p_bureaus) b)
  end,
  now(),
  now()
)
on conflict (client_id) do update
set
  admin_id = coalesce(excluded.admin_id, public.docs_reminders.admin_id),
  note     = coalesce(excluded.note, public.docs_reminders.note),
  bureaus  = (
    select case when count(*)=0 then null
                else array_agg(distinct b)
           end
    from unnest(
      coalesce(public.docs_reminders.bureaus, '{}'::text[])
      || coalesce(excluded.bureaus, '{}'::text[])
    ) b
  ),
  last_seen = now();
$function$
